nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Kể chuyện · bài tự soạn
kind: Chuyện vui: con mèo ăn trộm cá
L: Let me tell you about my cat, Mochi, who is a total thief.
She used to be shy, but now she steals food from the counter.
Last Friday I left a plate of fish on the counter and took a shower.
When I came back, the plate was empty and Mochi was sleeping like an angel.
She had already eaten the whole fish, and a tiny bone was stuck to her nose!
I wasn't angry, though, because she looked too cute to be punished.
Since that day, I have never left any food out when she is home.
Has your pet ever done something silly? Tell me!

exq.q: What did Mochi do last Friday?
exq.a: She ate a plate of fish.
exq.why: “She had already eaten the whole fish.”

exq.q: Where was the bone when the speaker came back?
exq.why: “a tiny bone was stuck to her nose”.

exq.q: Why was the speaker not angry?
w: She was still in the shower.
exq.why: “she looked too cute to be punished”.

exq.q: What is the speaker’s new rule?
exq.a: No food left out when Mochi is home.
exq.why: “I have never left any food out when she is home.”
